_comment: Hermetic by design. The eval matches against the JDs defined HERE, not against whatever happens to be in the database. Scoring a candidate who claims React experience against 25 arbitrary imported roles measures nothing — NONE would be the correct answer, and the expected verdicts below would be meaningless.

jds.title: Senior React Developer
jds.jd_text: We are looking for a Senior React Developer with 5+ years of experience building complex SPAs. Must have strong TypeScript skills, experience with state management (Redux/Zustand), and a track record of shipping production-grade applications.

jds.title: Node.js Backend Engineer
jds.jd_text: Seeking a Node.js Backend Engineer to design and implement RESTful APIs, manage PostgreSQL databases, and ensure high availability.

jds.title: DevOps Engineer
jds.jd_text: DevOps Engineer to manage CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and cloud operations on AWS.

cases.label: clear-application-strong
cases.input_text: Hi, I have 7 years of React experience and have led frontend teams at two startups. Proficient in TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and React Query. Happy to share my portfolio.

cases.label: split-message-part-one
cases.notes: A greeting alone is chatter. Classified as an application means batching is broken.

cases.label: split-message-joined
cases.input_text:
Hi sir good evening

I am interested in the backend role

4 years Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL. Worked on microservices at my current company. Docker basics.
cases.notes: The same conversation once chained. This is the case the old pipeline got wrong.

cases.label: jd-posting
cases.input_text: We are looking for a Senior React Developer with 5+ years building complex SPAs. Must have strong TypeScript, state management (Redux/Zustand), and a track record shipping production apps. Reporting to the frontend lead.

cases.label: jd-posting-informal
cases.input_text: need 2 devops guys asap. aws, terraform, ci/cd. remote ok. budget 15-20 lpa
cases.notes: Informal posting — commonly misread as chatter.

cases.label: thanks-chatter
cases.input_text: Thank you so much sir, waiting for your reply
cases.notes: Follow-up politeness should not create a candidate row.

cases.label: scheduling-chatter
cases.input_text: Can we do the call at 4pm tomorrow instead? I have a conflict at 2.

cases.label: bare-interest-unclear
cases.notes: Too thin to judge. Should reach a human, not get a confident verdict.

cases.label: cv-attachment-no-text
cases.notes: Attachment whose text could not be extracted, with no accompanying message. Belongs in review — there is nothing to classify.

cases.label: designer-claiming-react
cases.input_text: I am a designer who knows some React. Can build simple components. Interested in the role.
cases.notes: Evidence requirement should stop this being read as a senior React developer.

cases.label: vague-seniority-claim
cases.input_text: I am a senior full stack developer with extensive experience in modern web technologies and a proven track record of delivering scalable solutions.
cases.notes: All adjectives, no quotable specifics. Must not score STRONG on confident tone alone.

cases.label: unrelated-field
cases.input_text: I have 10 years experience in hotel management and front office operations. Looking for opportunities.
cases.notes: Real application, no matching open role.
